an3.60:1.1: atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
an3.60:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.60:1.5: tatra bho gotama yo ceva yajati, yo ca yajāpeti, sabbe te anekasārīrikaṃ puññapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannā honti yadidaṃ yaññādhikaraṇaṃ.
an3.60:1.6: yo panāyaṃ bho gotama yassa vā tassa vā kulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ekamattānaṃ dameti, ekamattānaṃ sameti, ekamattānaṃ parinibbāpeti, evamassāyaṃ ekasārīrikaṃ puññapaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti, yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti.
an3.60:2.1: tena hi brāhmaṇa, taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
an3.60:2.3: idha tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
an3.60:2.5: ethāyaṃ maggo, ayaṃ paṭipadā, yathā paṭipanno ahaṃ anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedemi,
an3.60:2.6: etha tumhepi tathā paṭipajjatha, yathā paṭipannā tumhepi anuttaraṃ brahmacariyogadhaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathāti.
an3.60:2.7: iti ayaṃ ceva satthā dhammaṃ deseti, pare ca tathattāya paṭipajjanti, tāni kho pana honti anekānipi satāni anekānipi sahassāni anekānipi satasahassāni.
an3.60:3.2: iccāyaṃ evaṃ sante ekasārīrikā vā puññapaṭipadā hoti anekasārīrikā vā, yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti?
an3.60:3.3: iccāyampi bho gotama, evaṃ sante anekasārīrikā puññapaṭipadā hoti, yadidaṃ pabbajjādhikaraṇanti.
an3.60:4.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
an3.60:4.2: imāsaṃ te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati, appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cāti?
an3.60:4.3: evaṃ vutte saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an3.60:4.5: ete me pujjā, ete me pāsaṃsāti.
an3.60:5.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
an3.60:5.2: na kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃ pucchāmi :
an3.60:5.3: ke vā te pujjā ke vā te pāsaṃsāti.
an3.60:5.5: imāsaṃ te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati, appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cāti.
an3.60:5.6: dutiyampi kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an3.60:5.8: ete me pujjā ete me pāsaṃsāti.
an3.60:6.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca :
an3.60:6.2: na kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa evaṃ pucchāmi:
an3.60:6.3: ke vā te pujjā ke vā te pāsaṃsāti.
an3.60:6.5: imāsaṃ te brāhmaṇa dvinnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamā paṭipadā khamati. appaṭṭhatarā ca appasamārambhatarā ca mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā cāti.
an3.60:6.6: tatiyampi kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca :
an3.60:6.8: ete me pujjā ete me pāsaṃsāti.
an3.60:7.2: yāvatatiyampi kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo ānandena sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti, no vissajjeti.
an3.60:7.4: atha kho bhagavā saṅgāravaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca :
an3.60:7.5: kānujja, brāhmaṇa, rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādīti?
an3.60:7.6: ayaṃ khvajja bho gotama, rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādi :
an3.60:7.7: pubbe sudaṃ appatarā ceva bhikkhū ahesuṃ, bahutarā ca uttari manussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassesuṃ.
an3.60:7.8: etarahi kho bahutarā ceva bhikkhū appatarā ca uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassentīti.
an3.60:7.9: ayaṃ khvajja bho gotama, rājantepure rājaparisāyaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ antarā kathā udapādīti.
an3.60:8.5: idha brāhmaṇa ekacco anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti : ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti, āvībhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamānova gacchati, seyyathāpi ākāse. paṭhaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake, udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati, seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ, ākāsepi pallaṅkena kamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. imepi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃ mahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati, parimajjati, yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
an3.60:9.3: evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti.
an3.60:9.4: so bahuṃ cepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:10.1: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekacco naheva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati:
an3.60:10.2: evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti.
an3.60:10.3: so bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:11.1: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekacco naheva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati:
an3.60:11.2: evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti.
an3.60:11.3: so bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:12.1: idha pana brāhmaṇa, ekacco na heva kho nimittena ādisati, napi manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati, napi vitakkayato napi vicārayato na vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati: api ca kho avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti.
an3.60:12.2: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amunnāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatīti.
an3.60:12.3: so bahuñcepi ādisati. tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:13.3: evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasi karotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathāti.
an3.60:13.6: imesaṃ te brāhmaṇa, tiṇṇaṃ pāṭihāriyānaṃ katamaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ khamati abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañcāti.
an3.60:14.1: tatra bho gotama yadidaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ, idhekacco anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti …pe…
an3.60:14.3: idaṃ bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ yova naṃ karoti, sova naṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. yova naṃ karoti, tasseva taṃ hoti.
an3.60:14.4: idaṃ me bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ māyāsahadhammarūpaṃ viya khāyati.
an3.60:15.1: yampidaṃ bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ idhekacco nimittena ādisati :
an3.60:15.2: evampi te mano, itthampi te mano, itipi te cittanti. so bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:15.3: idha pana bho gotama, ekacco naheva kho nimittena ādisati, api ca kho manussānaṃ vā amanussānaṃ vā devatānaṃ vā saddaṃ sutvā ādisati: …pe…
an3.60:15.4: api ca kho vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati …pe…
an3.60:15.5: napi vitakkayato vicārayato vitakkavipphārasaddaṃ sutvā ādisati, api ca kho avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
an3.60:15.6: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amunnāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatīti. so bahuñcepi ādisati, tatheva taṃ hoti, no aññathā.
an3.60:15.7: idampi bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ yova naṃ karoti sova naṃ paṭisaṃvedeti. yova naṃ karoti, tasseva taṃ hoti.
an3.60:15.8: idampi bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ māyāsahadhammarūpaṃ viya khāyati.
an3.60:16.1: yañca kho idaṃ bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ idhekacco evamanusāsati :
an3.60:16.2: evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasi karotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha, idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathāti.
an3.60:16.3: idameva bho gotama pāṭihāriyaṃ khamati imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ pāṭihāriyānaṃ abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca.
an3.60:17.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama, abbhutaṃ bho gotama,
an3.60:17.2: yāva subhāsitamidaṃ bhotā gotamena. imehi ca mayaṃ tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dhārema.
an3.60:17.3: bhavaṃ hi gotamo anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti …pe… yāva brahma lokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
an3.60:17.4: bhavaṃ hi gotamo avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti
an3.60:17.5: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amunnāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatīti. bhavaṃ
an3.60:17.7: evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha, evaṃ manasi karotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha. idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathāti.
an3.60:18.1: addhā kho tyāyaṃ brāhmaṇa āsajja upanīyavācā bhāsitā,
an3.60:18.3: hi brāhmaṇa anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhomi …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vattemi.
an3.60:18.4: ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhiṃ samāpannassa cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi,
an3.60:18.5: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā imassa cittassa anantarā amunnāma vitakkaṃ vitakkissatīti. ahaṃ
an3.60:18.7: evaṃ vitakketha, mā evaṃ vitakkayittha. evaṃ manasi karotha, mā evaṃ manasākattha. idaṃ pajahatha, idaṃ upasampajja viharathāti.
an3.60:19.1: atthi pana bho gotama añño ekabhikkhupi yo imehi tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgato? aññatra bhotā gotamenāti?
an3.60:19.2: na kho brāhmaṇa ekaññeva sataṃ, na dve satāni, na tīṇi satāni, na cattāri satāni, na pañcasatāni. atha kho bhiyyova ye bhikkhū imehi tīhi pāṭihāriyehi samannāgatāti.
an3.60:19.3: kahaṃ pana bho gotama etarahi te bhikkhū viharantīti?
an3.60:20.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
an3.60:20.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃgatanti.
